historical_references.reference: Qurum was a major port city and important center of the Maragha Empire. It is believed to have been an important trading hub between the Mediterranean and the Persian Gulf. The city was also known for its production of high-quality glass and ceramics.

Qurum was a significant political and cultural center during the Ayyubid period. It was the capital city of the Ayyubid emirate of Yemen. The city was known for its immense wealth, which was largely derived from the trade of frankincense and myrrh.
